title: Russia attacks Kyiv with ballistic missiles, drones hours after peace talks end
summary: Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported that one person was killed, and seven others were injured as a result of a Russian drone strike.

title: Russia's largest oil refinery slammed by drones in 8-hour attack 2,500 km from Ukraine
summary: The Omsk oil refinery, a Gazprom facility in Siberia, has a processing capacity of over 21 million metric tons of crude per year.

title: Witkoff, Kushner arrive in Moscow following Ukraine peace talks, Russian state media reports
summary: U.S. envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff arrived in Moscow early Nov. 12, Russian state media reported, following two days of Ukraine peace talks on Nov. 10-11 that failed to produce a meaningful breakthrough.

title: EU purchases of Russian Yamal LNG rise to over $9 billion in 2026, despite October dip
summary: The European bloc has already paid over one-fifth more for Yamal LNG this year than throughout the entire 2025, according to Urgewald.

title: Russia attacks Khmelnytskyi Oblast energy infrastructure, leaving outages
summary: "As a result of the Russian attack, energy infrastructure was damaged, causing emergency power outages in the Shepetivka district," Khmelnytskyi Oblast Governor Serhii Tiurin said.
